Kanwariyas Clash on Highway, Police Intervene Amidst Violence

A clash erupted between Kanwariyas on the Delhi-Dehradun highway after two motorcycles collided. The altercation escalated to the use of sticks and batons. When police personnel arrived to mediate, they were also reportedly pushed and beaten. The incident involved a significant number of participants and required police intervention to restore order.
